title: English Lost 30 Points as the Internet Globalized
hook: English lost 30 points when the rest of the world logged on.
closing: Searching only in English now hides almost half of the internet.
question: Which language do you browse in?

segments.say: English fell 30 percentage points as the web expanded beyond its early users.
Arabic content grew 2,501 percent, showing how quickly other languages built their own internet.
English still leads at 55 percent, but nearly half of websites now use other languages.
